items.name: Kure Beach Scallop Shell Printed Canvas Tote Bag
items.alt: Natural canvas tote bag printed with a navy and coral scallop shell, leaning on a dune beside a folded towel and straw hat, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A natural cotton canvas tote printed with one hand-inked navy and coral scallop shell. A Kure Beach tote for beach days and market trips.
facts: About 15 x 16 in with 20 in handles
Scallop shell drawing about 7 in wide on the front, printed not embroidered
